steps.caption: Each requirement has a status: draft, estimated, client confirmed, closed. Filter by it here.
It is saved as an estimate until the client confirms.
Give it a short title and pick the company — or type a new company name.
More details: area range and whether it is carpet or chargeable area.
Also: seats, fit-out standard, decision date, tenure and mandate.
Budget only if the client said it. We don't know, so it stays blank — unknown.
Top cards: how many mandatory facts are known and how many the client confirmed.
The requirement contract: each field is Estimated, Confirmed or Unknown.
Questions to ask: the gaps, most important first — take this list to your next call.
Update a field when the client answers, with the source of the answer.
Add where they want to be: Add location preference.
Preference: preferred, acceptable, must, or excluded.
Baner is now listed. Required features (parking, power…) are added the same way.
